description:
GDP.pdf
	

GDP.pdf measures professional multimodal reasoning over the documents the economy actually runs on: dense reports, contracts, filings, and records in the messy real-world formats professionals work from. It was cited in Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 model card.

	
		
	
	
		What it tests
	

The benchmark contains 100 real-world prompts and PDFs pulled directly from professional workflows across ten domains: Finance, Healthcare, Legal, STEM/Research, Engineering… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/surgeai/GDP.pdf.
